description: This plot illustrates the average cosine similarity between generated training samples for each relation category across different model configurations. The x-axis represents the "Relation Category" on a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 64, with numerical tick labels placed at intervals of 10. The y-axis is labeled "Mean Interclass Similarity" and uses a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 0.5, with tick marks spaced every 0.1 units. The "w/o DPO obo" data is depicted by a solid blue line with dot markers; it begins at a value of approximately 0.22 at category 0, exhibits significant fluctuations including a sharp peak near 0.49 at category 1 and another peak near 0.48 at category 30, before ending near 0.02 at category 64. The "w/o DPO obo & w/o div-hint" configuration is shown as a solid orange line with upward-pointing triangle markers, starting at approximately 0.10, fluctuating widely with notable peaks near 0.39 at category 16, 0.46 at category 30, and 0.47 at category 60, and finishing near 0.08. The "DPO" dataset is represented by a solid green line with small cross markers, beginning at approximately 0.19, fluctuating within a comparatively lower range with a peak of roughly 0.21 at category 1, and concluding near 0.06. Additionally, three dashed lines with no markers represent the averages for each configuration, remaining perfectly horizontal across the entire x-axis: the "Average of w/o DPO obo" is a dashed blue line at a specifically labeled y-value of 0.107, the "Average of w/o DPO obo & w/o div-hint" is a dashed orange line at a labeled y-value of 0.158, and the "Average of DPO" is a dashed green line at a labeled y-value of 0.086.
